title: Remove Fitness + Global Restrictions
body:
Pleaee remove fitness + global restrictions. 
There is a significant amount of people outside of English Speaking countries who can understand and comprehense a workout made with English speaking trainers. 
Please remove the global restrictions. 

If you are worrying about Legal Implications of having some one getting to an injury because of language difference, please overcome it with using a simple acknowledgement agreement. 
You can use a guided video to imply why it is important to understand the workout.
author: Bathiya Wickramage
